name: Bathyal-Skerry
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in a nearby asteroid belt. Travelers navigate by an ancient meteor crater and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
